proposal.summary: Authenticated SSRF in the Data Import module of Heartex - Label Studio Community Edition <= 1.5.0 allows an authenticated user to access arbitrary files on the system. Default-enabled self-registration permits remote attackers to create accounts and exploit the SSRF.
proposal.cwe_quote: A Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the Data Import module in Heartex - Label Studio Community Edition versions 1.5.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user to access arbitrary files on the system.

AV.quote: A Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the Data Import module in Heartex - Label Studio Community Edition versions 1.5.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user to access arbitrary files on the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by reproducing the SSRF with a test account, confirm whether it can read arbitrary local files, and if confirmed, apply or recommend an upstream patch and advise disabling self-registration until fixed.

evidence_quotes.quote: A Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the Data Import module in Heartex - Label Studio Community Edition versions 1.5.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user to access arbitrary files on the system.
self-registration is enabled by default in these versions of Label Studio enabling a remote attacker to create a new account and then exploit the SSRF.
